cues.show: You with the guitar, the chord boxes of the exercise on screen.
cues.say: These are chord boxes. Each one shows where your fingers go for one chord.

cues.show: Point along one chord box: the strings, the frets, a dot.
cues.say: The lines going down are the strings, with the thickest string on the left. The lines going across are the frets.

cues.show: Point along one chord box: the strings, the frets, a dot.
cues.say: Each dot is a finger, and the number on it says which finger: 1 is your first finger, 4 is your little finger.

cues.show: Tap a chord box to hear it. Then press Intervals, then Fingers again.
cues.say: Tap a chord box to hear the chord.

cues.show: Tap a chord box to hear it. Then press Intervals, then Fingers again.
cues.say: Press Intervals above the chord boxes to see which note of the chord each dot is. Press Fingers to go back to the finger numbers.

cues.show: Fretting hand close up: place the first chord one finger at a time, then pick each string.
cues.say: Put your fingers down one at a time, each one just behind its fret.

cues.show: Fretting hand close up: place the first chord one finger at a time, then pick each string.
cues.say: Then pick the strings one by one. If a string buzzes, move that finger closer to the fret and stand it up on its tip.

cues.show: Lift the hand off and put the chord back a few times, then change to the next chord box.
cues.say: Now lift your hand off and put the chord back. Practice until all your fingers land together.

cues.show: Play the chord a few different ways: strummed, one string at a time, only the thin strings.
cues.say: Try things with it. Strum it, then play one string at a time. Play only the three thinnest strings.

cues.show: Play the chord a few different ways: strummed, one string at a time, only the thin strings.
cues.say: Press Intervals and find the note marked 1, then play that note alone and sing it.

cues.show: Play the chord a few different ways: strummed, one string at a time, only the thin strings.
cues.say: Then do the same with the next chord box.
